title: Analyze and qualify a controlled upgrade from @github/copilot-sdk 1.0.8 and the fork bundled CLI 1.0.75 to a compatible SDK/runtime pair. Assess SDK 1.0.28 as a candidate, not an approved minimum. Preserve native CLI session continuity, provider-instance account/home isolation, permission and input receipts, cancellation, completion and existing model selection. Analyze dynamic routing discovery needed by copilot-fusion-model-selection, native runtime packaging and platform staging, source-server resolution defect #34, and focused regression gates for macOS, Windows and WSL/Linux. Compare priority and sequencing with Fusion integration. Analysis only: no dependency installation, runtime changes, paid turns, experimental flags, deployment, or implementation.
